description: This figure illustrates an $S_r$ ratio ablation study, comparing perplexity and GPU memory ratio against the recent sequence ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale with labeled tick marks ranging from 20 to 100 at intervals of 20, though the plotted data points begin at an x-value of 10. The plot utilizes dual y-axes. The left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity," has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, and displays tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)," features a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, and has tick marks at intervals of 10. Four lines are displayed on the graph. The "Perplexity" data is represented by a solid orange line with circular markers, corresponding to the left y-axis. It begins at approximately 4.6 at an x-value of 10, declines to roughly 4.28 at x=40, fluctuates slightly before reaching a minimum of approximately 4.25 at x=70, and then rises to end at 4.42 at x=100. The "Full Cache PPL" is shown as a dashed orange line, which remains constant at a perplexity value of approximately 4.42 across the entire x-axis. The "GPU Mem. Ratio" is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, corresponding to the right y-axis. This line starts at approximately 42% at x=10, exhibits a steady, gradual increase to roughly 58% at x=80, experiences a sharp rise to approximately 95% at x=90, and concludes at 100% at x=100. Finally, the "Full Cache GPU Mem." is represented by a dashed blue line, which maintains a constant value of 100% across the entire x-axis.
